title: A Tan Pot and a Nut
lines: Nan and Tom sit on a mat.
A nut is in a pot.
Tom can not tip it up.
"Do it," said Nan. Nan and Tom tip it up.
The nut is up! It is at the pot.
Tom can tip it to a cup.
scoring_note: This passage says "can not", "it is". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "can't" or "it's" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
